authority: _validation_registry.json is the executable source of truth; _repo_validation_matrix.json is generated from it.

HARD_FAIL.meaning: Direct production, user-safety, evidence, route, workflow, build, or delivery threat; never cosmetic formatting.

STRONG_WARNING.meaning: Material quality, ingestion, indexing, accessibility, or performance degradation.

SOFT_WARNING.meaning: Maintainability, documentation, style, or low-risk quality concern.

INFO.meaning: Metric, observation, historical evidence, or optimization note.

scope_definitions.CONTAINER: Runnable in the standard container without provider credentials.
scope_definitions.LOCAL_ONLY: Requires deployed URL, browser runtime, credentials, or operator environment.

core.description: Pure default release-blocking checks; no mutation and no external provider dependency.

release.description: Full container release proof: core plus source immutability, hygiene, and deterministic build.

strict.description: Release proof plus advisory checks; strong warnings are promoted to failure.

advisory.description: Non-blocking quality and ingestion warnings only.

local.description: Full release proof plus deployed Playwright click audit.

audit.description: Collect-all execution of every active and on-demand validator; local-only checks are deferred unless explicitly enabled.

social.description: Public-signal normalization and candidate loop validation.

llm.description: LLM export, answer-block, entity-graph, and citation-target validation.

homepages.description: Homepage-only schema and assistance boundary checks.

canonical-data.description: Protected canonical source static and runtime immutability checks.

postrelease.description: Pure post-build structural verification; no content release or mutation.

content-release.description: Lean content-release checks for generated static content and routing contracts.

agent-run.description: Agent artifact ingestion, FIX compilation, exact implementation, and semantic acceptance proof.

full-audit.description: Hostile collect-all review of all active validators without pretending every advisory check belongs in core.

citation-intelligence.description: Traffic-qualified citation intelligence, proof packet, atom, structural graph, and workflow topology gates.

deep-isolated.description: Isolated deep container validation: workflow data trace, browserless mock backup, and traffic-qualified citation intelligence only. No real browser claim.

validators.title: Validation registry admission and matrix parity
validators.risk_prevented: Unregistered, duplicated, mutating, or misclassified validators can create false confidence and pipeline drift.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: No individual domain validator can prove that the validation system itself is complete and centrally governed.

validators.title: Validation severity policy self-test
validators.risk_prevented: A runner regression could silently treat a hard failure as a warning or turn advisory findings into false release blockers.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Registry schema validation proves classification data, but only this self-test proves the executable severity policy.

validators.title: Repository authority contracts

lineage_policy.authority: _validation_registry.json is the executable source of truth for validation selection, dependency order, prerequisites, outputs, severity, and mutation boundaries.
lineage_policy.dependency_rule: Dependencies are included recursively and executed in topological order before dependents.
lineage_policy.prerequisite_rule: Missing required files trigger registered prepare_commands. Unregistered preparation is forbidden.
lineage_policy.mutation_rule: Validator commands may write only declared mutates_files. Source roots are hash-checked before and after each validator.
lineage_policy.output_rule: Declared produces_files must exist after a passing validator.

release_blocking_policy.clarification: Whitespace inside a URL or href remains a broken-link defect, not a formatting defect.
